description: Land Acquisition - Denagamuwa, Hewanawatta & Mihi-ella, Mallawapitiya D/S Division, Kurunegala District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act, detailing specific land parcels being acquired for public purposes. It contains descriptions of land lots, their locations, extents, and claimant information, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
